description: The closed write-target set for /execute. This file is the source of truth; skills/execute/SKILL.md (Security Considerations, point 2) points here rather than restating the set. A write outside this set fails the R9 hard-finalization check.

path_classes.title: State file and scratch
path_classes.description: The wip-yaml-md state projection and any scratch keyed on the topic slug. Non-durable: the finalization cascade plus the squash-merge carry it off main.

path_classes.title: The skill's own files
path_classes.description: SKILL.md, the lifted koto template, the scripts, the references, and the evals that ship with /execute.

path_classes.title: Finalization cascade chain transitions
path_classes.description: The atomic chain transitions the cascade performs: PLAN deletion plus the BRIEF/PRD/DESIGN/ROADMAP transitions, including the DESIGN move into docs/designs/current/.

path_classes.title: Decision Records on re-evaluation
path_classes.description: The Decision Record /execute writes when it exits at an upstream-must-change boundary.

command_classes.title: Home PR and coordination body
command_classes.description: The remote writes /execute makes, all through gh against the home pull request or the coordination PR body. Filing issues is deliberately absent: an automated run-report emit would add a remote target outside this set and needs an R9 amendment first.
